text.en: RL-designed magnetic controller is row 109 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the AI4Science area.
text.zh: RL-designed magnetic controller 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 109 行，所属领域为“AI for Science”。

text.en: The annual table associates RL-designed magnetic controller with “Magnetic control of tokamak plasmas through deep reinforcement learning”.
text.zh: 年度表把 RL-designed magnetic controller 与论文《Magnetic control of tokamak plasmas through deep reinforcement learning》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Jonas Degrave, Federico Felici, Jonas Buchli, Michael Neunert, Brendan Tracey”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Jonas Degrave（官方页拼写）、Federico Felici（官方页拼写）、Jonas Buchli（官方页拼写）、Michael Neunert（官方页拼写）、Brendan Tracey（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Jonas Degrave, Federico Felici, Jonas Buchli, Michael Neunert, Brendan Tracey”。
